existing_event_updates.summary: Iranian navy and IRGC Navy asserted three tankers struck mines and caught fire November 14, one in eastern strait in morning and two later; Reuters could not independently verify. Potential overlap with prior tanker claims unresolved.

geospatial.source_location_description: Strait of Hormuz; eastern strait described for first tanker, two later vessels without vessel-specific coordinates

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters November 14 reported three sources saying Trump privately considered withholding further strikes absent new Iran/Houthi provocations. Not an implemented ceasefire or formal operational order.

AP reports hospital officials said two Palestinians killed and others wounded by Israeli drone strike in Jabaliya; Israel says targets were Hamas militants. Casualty report and target attribution kept distinct.

geospatial.source_location_description: Jabaliya, northern Gaza; no street or impact coordinates verified

claims_and_corrections.claim: Three oil tankers hit mines and caught fire November 14 in Strait of Hormuz
Jabaliya drone strike targeted two Hamas militants

human_impact_updates.summary: UN assistant secretary-general Khaled Khiari reported at least 25 seafarers killed in and around Hormuz since February, as of November 11. Cumulative figure, not November 14 deaths.
